column1: # The files each e2e case runs: which cases a pull request can affect.
# scripts/ci/e2e-scope.sh reads this file to pick the cases of a pull
# request's e2e run (docs/testing.md, "Which cases a pull request runs").
#   case   the file name in tests/e2e without .sh
#   paths  the files the case runs, as globs separated by spaces (matched as in
#          bash [[ PATH == GLOB ]], so * matches slashes too and
#          modules/local/lpa/* is the whole module), or - for none beyond the
#          case's own file. A base case's row is always -: whenever any case
#          runs, the base leg runs every base case.
# A case runs on a pull request when one of its globs matches a changed path,
# when its own file or one of its table rows changes, when a case that runs
# needs it, or when it is one of the smoke cases. A change to shared wiring
# (FULL in e2e-scope.sh: main.nf, the workflows, the config, the shared
# library, the launcher, the alignment and calling steps, the fixture, the
# e2e runner) runs every case. Every case needs a row, and every glob must
# match a tracked file: e2e-scope.sh check fails otherwise. List the step
# scripts, bin helpers, modules and assets the case calls, and what those
# call in turn; listing too much costs runner time, listing too little lets a
# break reach main, where the full run after the merge catches it.
